requirements: R1: Fix connection refused error on localhost:18080 during health check after launch

slices.title: Fix launch health check connection refused
slices.jtbd: When implementing the launch fix for this epic, I want the backend service on port 18080 to be healthy and accessible, so that the launch is successful.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application stack is launched via standard scripts, When the health check script queries http://localhost:18080/health, Then it should return a 200 OK status instead of a connection refused error.
Given the service is configured to run, When the container starts, Then it binds correctly to port 18080 and accepts external connections.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce system launch failures from 1 to 0
